runs.t: Load balancing distributes requests or work across instances to improve utilization, capacity and availability. Policies range from round robin and least connections to locality- and health-aware routing.

Design health and readiness signals, connection draining, retries, sticky sessions only when necessary, and proxy timeout behavior. Consider L4 versus L7 routing and how algorithms interact with unequal workloads.
A web API balances traffic across three replicas and drains a retiring instance before stopping it. Long WebSocket sessions may need different connection handling than short HTTP requests.
A healthy process is not necessarily ready for traffic. Retries at the load balancer can duplicate non-idempotent operations, and sticky sessions complicate scale-out and failover.
